page.overview:
What is Mana Matrix?

The Mana Matrix was an artifact used by Leshrac in his duel with Kristina of the Woods and Taysir of Rabiah in the Nether Void during the Summit of the Null Moon. The Matrix allowed him to gather more mana in the Void than would be naturally possible, giving him a distinct advantage.
